summary.text: Danielle Conrad is a member of the Nebraska Legislature who represented District 46 from 2007 to 2015, returned in January 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Conrad was born in Seward, Nebraska, and graduated from Seward High School in 1995.
She earned a B.A. in political science from the University of Nebraska-Lincoln in 2000 and a J.D. from the University of Nebraska College of Law in 2003.
Her career experience includes working as an attorney for the Nebraska Appleseed Center for Law in the Public Interest.
Conrad first held the District 46 seat from 2007 to 2015, and she assumed office again on January 4, 2023.
Ballotpedia lists her 2025-2026 committee assignments as Education, Natural Resources and Nebraska Retirement Systems.
She advanced from the May 12, 2026 primary.
